title: Chhattisgarh Launches 'DWEEPTI Yojana' for Women-Led Rooftop Solar Enterprises
summary: 1st Indian state to adopt a women-led distributed renewable energy policy training 'Solar Didis'.

blocks.content: 1st Indian state to adopt a women-led distributed renewable energy policy training 'Solar Didis'.

items: Policy Scope: Places women SHGs at center of rooftop solar expansion to establish 5,000 women-led energy enterprises over 5 years.
Target Reach: 50,000 green jobs and clean energy access for 5 lakh families across Chhattisgarh.
Technical Partners: Jointly developed by Panchayat Dept and Transform Rural India under Green Economy Transition Mission.
